# Q3 Sales Report — James Okafor (Won Deals)

## Overview

This report highlights selected won deals closed by **James Okafor** during Q3 2026, specifically deals **D001**, **D003**, and **D006**.

## Deal Details

| Deal ID | Region | Product               | Amount    | Close Date | Status |
|---------|--------|-----------------------|-----------|------------|--------|
| D001    | North  | Meridian Insights Pro | $87,500   | 2026-07-05 | Won    |
| D003    | East   | Meridian DataBridge   | $43,000   | 2026-07-12 | Won    |
| D006    | South  | Meridian Insights Pro | $120,000  | 2026-07-22 | Won    |

## Summary

- **Total Value:** $250,500
- **Number of Deals:** 3
- **Close Period:** All three deals closed in July 2026
- **Products Sold:**
  - Meridian Insights Pro — 2 deals ($207,500)
  - Meridian DataBridge — 1 deal ($43,000)
- **Regions Covered:** North, East, South

## Key Takeaways

1. James Okafor's largest deal in this selection was **D006** (Meridian Insights Pro, South region) at **$120,000**.
2. Meridian Insights Pro accounts for **83%** of the total value across these three deals.
3. All deals were closed within the first month of Q3, demonstrating a strong start to the quarter.

---

*Source: data/sales_q3.csv*
